provenance.l: New Glenn — Wikipedia (98 m, 7 m; GS1 7× BE-4, 19,928 kN, 340 s, ~190 s burn; GS2 2× BE-3U, 445 s, ~644 s burn; Blue Moon MK1 21,715 kg)

BE-3U — Wikipedia: 712 kN, uprated to 765 kN (Jeff Bezos, Aug 2024), then 778 kN / 175,000 lbf after the April 2025 second-stage hotfire (Dave Limp). GS2 flies 1,559.5 kN, fitted to NG-2's SECO-1 at T+773 s, 0.2 % from 2 × 778 kN. blueorigin.com's engine page is script-rendered and gave no text (2026-11-22)
Blue Origin lists the BE-4 at 2,450 kN per engine: 7 × = 17,150 kN at liftoff; GS1 sea-level Isp derived from the SL/vacuum thrust ratio

Stage masses are not published: propellant derived from thrust × burn time / (Isp × g0) (GS1 ~1,135 t, GS2 ~262 t); dry masses and fairing mass estimated. Blue Moon MK1 is planned for 2027 and its own BE-7 makes the trans-lunar burn from low Earth orbit
NASA — Important launch milestones for ESCAPADE (NG-2): fairings jettison T+00:03:50 = 230 s (MECO 185 s, stage separation 189 s)
